verdict.rationale: Sandboxed testing is a fair question for a coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence shows /test, /run and --auto-test commands, but these run in the user's local environment with no documented isolation from production data. Git auto-commits, /undo and read-only /ask mode are rollback or no-edit features, not a sandbox environment, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
